errors.description: A verified service principal is required
The payment is already bound to a different job/resource/order
Treasury or the facilitator is unavailable

rest_exception.note: Private service-to-service verification. Successful verification creates a durable resource-scoped authorization but does not settle payment.

endpoints.summary: Settle one previously verified LPBS x402 authorization idempotently

errors.description: A verified service principal is required
The resource admission was not found
The admission is bound to a different job/resource/order
Settlement is still in progress or needs same-admission recovery

rest_exception.note: Private service-to-service settlement. Replays use the same durable admission and protected payment nonce; settled receipts are emitted by Treasury only once.

endpoints.summary: Cancel an unsettled LPBS x402 authorization when its delivery verifier declines

errors.description: A verified service principal is required
The resource admission was not found
The admission does not match or settlement has already started
Protected payload cleanup is temporarily unavailable; retry the same cancellation

rest_exception.note: Private service-to-service release. Cancellation is allowed only for a matching verified admission before settlement begins; it never calls the facilitator.

endpoints.summary: Read one accepted Treasury x402 seller receipt for LPBS reconciliation

errors.description: A Treasury x402 transaction external ID is required
A verified service principal is required
No accepted receipt exists for this transaction
More than one accepted receipt has this transaction identity

rest_exception.note: Private service-to-service reconciliation endpoint. A narrowly scoped verified service principal receives only the accepted receipt matching the exact x402 transaction identity.
